name: Fragrance ~Ryoujoku no Choukou~
original_name: フレグランス～凌辱の調香～
source:
Main character's sister has become a doll-like being after some event. Protagonist tries to investigate it and finds a note with three sister names on it. His revenge is going to be remorseless.
